Literacy, Mandarin/dialect familiarity, vision, and hearing can affect test performance. Inspect nonnumeric responses and distinguish cannot-answer, don't-know, refusal, non-assessment, and other missingness; do not infer a cognitive error from missingness. Sensitivity restrictions by literacy/language/sensory impairment may change the target population or induce bias, so define the estimand before restricting the sample. Official CHARLS-HCAP User Guidance notes that Wave 4 ten-word memory content and administration differ from prior waves; three immediate-recall trials were used, elevating delayed recall scores. Raw Wave 4 memory scores must not be treated as directly comparable change; the guidance recommends equipercentile-equated scores for longitudinal memory analyses. The Data Alert also cautions that some CERAD words may be unfamiliar.

Literacy, Mandarin/dialect familiarity, vision, and hearing can affect test performance. Inspect nonnumeric responses and distinguish cannot-answer, don't-know, refusal, non-assessment, and other missingness; do not infer a cognitive error from missingness. Sensitivity restrictions by literacy/language/sensory impairment may change the target population or induce bias, so define the estimand before restricting the sample. Official CHARLS-HCAP User Guidance notes that Wave 4 ten-word memory content and administration differ from prior waves; three immediate-recall trials were used, elevating delayed recall scores. Raw Wave 4 memory scores must not be treated as directly comparable change; the guidance recommends equipercentile-equated scores for longitudinal memory analyses.
